scope.lifetime: Application screen commands and button requests own AbortControllers; simultaneous commands remain independent. findings.issue: Synchronous first fix could resolve before setup returned, masking setup/cleanup errors.
findings.resolution: Reserve first callback and settle after setup; exact cleanup runs before success. Controlled mutation produces two failing setup/cleanup cases; restored helper passes, including first-delivery and late-error checks.

findings.issue: Finite MapLibre iOS seconds could overflow to Infinity when converted to milliseconds.
findings.resolution: Validate converted timestamp; controlled mutation fails overflow regression, restored helper rejects it.

findings.origin: Ownership gap exposed by service removal, coordinator and independent audit
findings.issue: Browser permission acquisition lacked scene signal; commands could return stale success after disposal when integration ignored abort.
findings.resolution: Each permission/position command owns a controller, browser permission watch receives it, scene cleanup aborts pending owners and post-await guard rejects stale success. Controlled guard removal fails both tests; final restoration passes.

findings.issue: Grouped negative imports proved only one removed type; bare Promise did not exercise ownership; blocked Android result and manual Platform mutation lacked accurate proof/isolation.
findings.resolution: Individual export negatives; actual acquireLocation survives setup unmount then owner abort releases exactly; blocked:true branch and exact setup-failure release covered; Platform descriptor restored. Selected raw manager alias/method positives added.
